messages.subject: Brookfield Energy | Country execution around development growth and strategic partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Brookfield Renewable Team,

Please route this confidential executive note to Mr. Lluís Noguera, Managing Partner and Global Head of Development, Energy.

Brookfield's 2026 energy thesis is increasingly an execution thesis. Power demand, data infrastructure, industrial reshoring and energy security are creating large development opportunities, but the projects themselves are becoming more dependent on governments, regulators, strategic customers, communities and local delivery partners. Your global development remit sits directly across those interfaces.

As Brookfield scales renewable and transition projects, I see value in strengthening the country-execution layer around development: market-entry intelligence, institutional mapping, government relationships, stakeholder strategy, local participation, ESG commitments and structured escalation when external dependencies threaten schedule or operating confidence. Those capabilities become especially important in emerging and frontier markets.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work connects foreign investment with ministries, regulators, communities, contractors and internal decision-makers in a capital-intensive operating environment. I lead or coordinate government relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, and I support stakeholder governance around industrial solar and battery storage.

I would welcome a conversation about where this operating-side country and stakeholder profile might support Brookfield Energy's development platform, portfolio companies or market-entry programs. I have attached a concise CV tailored to the government, stakeholder and responsible-infrastructure dimensions of Brookfield's growth agenda.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
